objections.claim: The clean-room `pylae verify --full --bundle` contract cannot authenticate the authority chain from the stated tarball + history bundle inputs. E2 requires both `CURRENT_AUTHORITY_CHAIN_ROOT` and `EYE_AUTHORITY_PUBKEY` to remain out-of-tree protected values, but neither value is distributed to operators through an independently authenticated release asset or explicit verification input; the bundle and extracted tree cannot supply them without becoming self-authorizing, and even the release-acceptance signature cannot be verified without the missing public key. Thus the claimed full clean-room battery must either fail for absent roots or trust values controlled by the tree writer. Specify an authenticated trust-root manifest/distribution chain plus missing/substituted-root regressions.
